verdict_scope: KEEP / REMOVE_OK compare the window's trades by regime. A Phase 1A-beta cube (B395, R5) runs with --no-regime-affinity (run_phase1a.py), so what removal drops AND what it adds are both observed; a regime-side cell with 0 trades is unobserved (R5's window holds no crisis day) and by_direction flags it. A run with the affinity ON holds only allowed regimes, and its added cells read 0 for that reason
